name: Gasthof Kienbergklamm
kurzbeschreibung:
**Welcome to Gasthof Kienbergklamm in Kufstein**

Discover authentic Tyrolean hospitality in the heart of the **Kufstein** region. Nestled in the picturesque **Kienbergklamm** gorge, our cozy inn offers a warm retreat after a day of exploring the stunning landscapes of **Tirol**.

Indulge in traditional Tyrolean cuisine—savor hearty dishes like **Kaiserschmarrn**, **Schlutzkrapfen**, or a perfectly grilled **Tiroler Gröstl**. Pair your meal with a glass of local **Apfelstrudel** or a frothy **Tiroler Bier** from our selection of regional brews.

Our rustic yet comfortable rooms feature Tyrolean charm, with wooden beams and cozy furnishings. After a day of hiking in the **Kaisergebirge** or skiing in the nearby **SkiWelt Wilder Kaiser-Brixental**, unwind in our inviting lounge or on the sunny terrace with panoramic views of the **Inn** River valley.

Just a short drive from **Innsbruck**, **Gasthof Kienbergklamm** is your ideal base for adventure and relaxation in the breathtaking **Tirol** Alps. Whether you're seeking outdoor thrills or a peaceful escape, we’re here to make your stay unforgettable.

**Come experience the warmth of Tyrol—where every visit feels like coming home.**
